scope: rotationally symmetric m=0 Maxwell fields with magnetic induction, distributed conduction, open free space, and PML
limitations: The RF geometry uses sharp cylindrical plate edges; electrostatic peak-field decisions continue to use the rounded FEniCSx geometry.
Non-axisymmetric leads, cavity modes, and the MELF spiral require a 3D solve.
The terminal excitation is a distributed radial lumped port across each end core-to-ground aperture.
low_frequency_solver: FEniCSx electroquasistatic Maxwell limit through shared 300 MHz and 1 GHz overlap points
resonance_search: optional coarse MEEP sweep followed by fine-grid bracketing around measured and low-loss RLC candidates

resonance_verification.definition: A verified resonance is a fine-grid local transmission maximum with lower solved points on both sides.

eqs_mesh.symmetry: full stack with one axial rigid-body anchor

overlap_validation.note: The lower shared point sets one constant port offset; the upper shared point independently checks slope.

numerical_accuracy_note: Default rerun at residual tolerance 1e-8. Convergence does not establish EQS/MEEP port equivalence; failed overlap remains diagnostic only.
